release_notes: 2nd-generation Cell PT 4G, distinct from the 1st-gen (IPC-K9EP-3T0TE-EU). Marketed as '2K QHD' but the 2304x1296 sensor is ~3MP. Specs from the 2nd-gen manual + distributor listings. Corrected 2026-10-30 against the official Imou spec sheet: battery 15000mAh → 10000mAh (spec page and datasheet), night_vision.type ir → hybrid (2 white-light lamps + 1 IR lamp), added aperture F1.6, storage.cloud true → false (datasheet: "Cloud Storage: Not Support"), added model code IPC-B7ED-3T1TEH. Official sources disagree on night-vision range (20 m page / 25 m datasheet), microSD (512/256 GB), weight (737.7/640 g) and power (<3.5/<4.9 W); the page values are kept.

frigate.notes: 100% wire-free battery camera — it sleeps between events and does not expose a continuous local RTSP stream, so Frigate/local-NVR use is not supported. Recording is via the Imou Life app + cloud and on-device microSD.
